# Code Crafting Introduction ~ 20 minutes
### Step 1. Discuss your challenge with your group

### Step 2. Open a new Data Foundry Project
**Important:**
Use the CodeCrafting template
### Step 3. Open the coding agent
**Link:** 
https://data.id.tue.nl/tools/codingagent
### Step 4. Start outlining your plan 
Give a description of what you want to create, this can be through multiple messages
to ask a question to the Agent, tag the agent with @boter
Boter can also ask you questions to inspire you.
It is important you outline what the end result should be; file type, name etc.
Talk about styling and outline some of the main interactions with your website.
### Step 5. Ask boter to create an overview "website.md"
Should be something like: "@boter can you summarize my wishes and create a detailed plan for my website in a website.md file"
### Step 6. Go through the website.md 
Add some stuff to it or modify it. Just try to interact with it.
### Step 7. Build!
finish the conversation until boter talks about implementation then
Ask @Boter to start implementing the site!
### * Step 8. fix?
if there is any issues, fix it, show students where they can find the error logs in the browser, and send along the logs to boter!
